body:
Added mail-accounts.provision permission (IsProvider/EventUserProviderChanged, mirrors IsAdmin's own CP-SIP-ADMIN-124323 pattern), scoped server-side minimum-necessary access (mail_account_credentials.created_by) so a provider only ever sees mailboxes they themselves created, and let providers create the participant's local_uid identity too (not just the mailbox). 11 new tests, go build/vet/test ./... clean. commit 7a4ae5c.

⚓ ☃
title: Least-privilege 'provider' role for HIPAA-aware participant mailbox provisioning
